name: Yousign
positioning: European electronic signature with eIDAS qualification — the French default where a signature must hold in a French court.
description: Yousign is a French electronic signature and contract platform: simple, advanced and qualified signature levels under eIDAS, identity verification, approval workflows, templates, audit trails and an API, with data hosted in the European Union.
real_estate_use: Mandates, lease agreements, offers and état des lieux are all signed remotely now, and the question that matters is evidentiary weight. eIDAS levels are not decoration: a qualified signature carries a legal presumption a simple one does not. French agency software integrates Yousign for exactly that reason, alongside the EU hosting requirement many professional bodies impose.
features: Simple, advanced and qualified eIDAS signature levels
Reusable document templates and signature workflows
Legally admissible audit trail per signature
API and connectors to business software

use_cases.job: Have a mandate or offer signed remotely with a signature that holds legally
Sign leases and état des lieux with tenants without a physical appointment
